data.narrative:
Orbital Operations is a Seed-stage space and aerospace company founded by Ben Schleuniger and Ross Doherty that has raised $8.8M to date. The sector comp universe includes 5 public companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers spanning various maturity levels, though the narrow peer set at identical stage and valuation tier is insufficient for reliable median-based triangulation.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, the only applicable approach given data constraints. Using total capital raised ($8.8M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A advancement yields an implied value of $22M. Public Space & Aerospace comparables trade at a 24.4x median P/S multiple (across RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL), but cannot be applied without the target's revenue disclosure. Peer-median analysis is not feasible due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage private comparables within the sector.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $19M to $25M, centered at $22M. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue or comparable near-stage private transactions to validate stage progression assumptions, and limited visibility into Orbital Operations' specific operational progress and capital efficiency relative to the broader Space & Aerospace ecosystem. Any refinement would require either disclosed financial metrics or identification of more granular private comparables at similar funding stages.
